what: SURF-v2's networks (surf_v2/REGISTRATION.md): the six networks retrained without line supervision, and R17's d = 17 policy for the deployed network; convlines.decoder.config reads this file after weights/configs.json. sha256, final_ema_sha256 and policy are set by the freeze (surf_v2/freeze.py); before it a weight file is read unchecked, and a read needing tau refuses a network without a policy.

d7_b1w64_sv2.format: safetensors, fp32 state dict of convlines.net.ConvLines (including the buffer A): the final_ema.pt state of the stage without the training-only read-out (surf_v2/export.py)
d7_b1w64_sv2.deployed_executable: timing/d7 (a hand-written persistent CUDA kernel for sm_90a with the weights resident in shared memory, and its compiled router; built by timing/d7/build.sh)

policy.rule: ising-arch:ising_compare/arch/policy.py fit (lines 117-165), executed as written: tau_q = float(np.quantile(|c|, q)) for q > 0 (numpy's default interpolation on the float32 |c|), tau_0 = 0; a shot is routed when |c| < tau_q (float32 |c| against tau_q); r_q = routed / N; F_cal(q) = failures with the routed shots taking correlated PM's calibration answer; admissible when projected(q) <= bar; limit L = M - 2 sqrt(2 M); the smallest admissible q with F_cal(q) <= L, else the fallback of the distance's registered policy (fallback): the largest admissible q at d = 7, the admissible q with the fewest calibration failures (ties: the smaller q) at d = 9-17; no admissible q: no policy (the network alone, labelled)
